name: Hurrakify
author: hurraki

sections.description:
Hurrakify adds tooltips to articles. That means: Hard-to-read word are underlinded. Moving over with the cursor shows a explanation about the word. Hurrakify gets its information from the Hurraki Plain Language Lexicon. Install and activate. Hurrakify does the rest.

To see the Plugin in action have a look at the Hurraki Blog.

Hurraki is a dictionary in Plain Language.
Many written and spoken words are complicated.
Some people don’t understand difficult words and text.
With Plain Language, everybody can understand.
For anyone – free to use.
Plain Language should be available in many languages.
Join Hurraki and help people to understand.

Settings

There are a few settings for Hurrakify.

After the installation, there is the new menu item Hurrakify.

The following settings are possible:

Where should Hurrakify get the tooltips from?

From the German, English, Hungarian, Italian or Spanish Dictionary.

In addition, you can adjust in which areas the tooltips should be added to the blog.

And how many tooltips per page should be displayed at maximum.
sections.installation:
There are two ways to install Hurrakify.

First Option:

  1. In the WordPress installation click on Plugin

  2. Click Install

  3. In the search field, type Hurrakify

  4. Click Install

Second Option:

  1. Download Plugin from WordPress.org

  2. Unzip the zip file

  3. Upload the complete folder to /wp-content/plugins/

Then go to the menu item Plugins to activate Hurrakify.

Now a new menu item with the name Hurrakify appears.
sections.faq:
Hurrakify does not add a Tooltip

Hurrakify retrieves the words from the respective German, English, Spanish or Hungarian lexicon. Depending on what is specified in the settings. If the word does not exist in the dictionary, no tooltip is added. Anyone can create new articles in the dictionary. Add the word in the respective Wiki in the “All Words” category, so that Hurrakify can find the word.

I have discovered an error in the plugin

Report the error at Github under point Issue

I am a programmer and would like to improve Hurrakify

The code for Hurrakify is available at Github
sections.changelog:
8.0.2

  • Tooltips are stored on the website for one week, so each explanation is fetched from Hurraki only once
  • If Hurraki cannot be reached, the plugin waits 15 minutes before asking again
  • Requests to Hurraki now identify themselves as “Hurrakify”
  • Fixed: links inside a tooltip pointed to “undefined/wiki/…”
  • Fixed: words with spaces or “&” were requested incorrectly
  • The “more” link now uses the standard wiki address (spaces as “_”); the Italian “more” link no longer contains a double slash
  • Fixed: tooltips did not work with themes that do not load jQuery (e.g. block themes)
  • Fixed: a word containing special characters such as ( or . could make the article text disappear
  • Faster: words that do not appear in an article are skipped quickly
  • The weekly update of the word list is now also set up on older installations, at a random time
  • Uninstall now also removes the scheduled event and the stored tooltips
  • Settings are checked before they are saved
  • Internal function names now start with “hurrakify_” (WordPress coding standards)

8.0.1

  • Implemented semantic software versioning

2.4

  • Fixed several bugs
  • Added a scheduled update event

2.3

  • Added Italian Plain Language dictionary
  • Changed API to https

2.2

  • Added Hungarian Plain Language dictionary
  • Fixed one bug

2.1

  • Added English Plain Language dictionary
  • Added Spanish Plain Language dictionary
